observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a tire tread, standing on a bare floor.
Tread pattern shows multiple circumferential grooves, visible wear and some embedded dirt.
No sidewall is visible in the frame, so no brand, model, size, or DOT/date code can be read.
A second tire is partly visible in the background, also unidentified.
A watermark reading 'POSTED ON JIJI N.J. VENTURE' overlays the image; this is a listing stamp, not proof of the item's specifics.
Surface shows some fine cracking lines on the tread blocks, typical of aged rubber, but severity can't be judged without a clearer or sidewall shot.

claims.evidence: Sidewall with size marking is not visible in photo 0; only tread is shown.
No import sticker, grade mark, or sidewall text visible to confirm origin or used-import status.

risks.risk: True tire size may differ from claimed 295/40 R20, which affects fitment and price.
risks.proof: Clear sidewall photo showing the size, load/speed rating molded on the rubber.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unspecified/unverified-size used tire, lower-confidence bracket

risks.risk: Brand and manufacturing date (age) unknown; older tires are worth less regardless of tread.
risks.proof: Sidewall photo showing brand name and DOT date code (4-digit week/year stamp).

risks.risk: Remaining tread depth not measurable from this angle; wear could be uneven or near legal limit.
risks.proof: Photo with a tread depth gauge or coin inserted in the main grooves, plus a full top-down shot of tread.
risks.if_unproven: priced as minimum usable tread (near end-of-life)

risks.risk: Visible fine cracking could indicate dry rot/age-related sidewall weakness, a safety and value issue.
risks.proof: Close-up of full sidewall showing any cracking, bulges, or repairs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having sidewall cracking present

risks.risk: Tire could be a mismatched single or part of a worn set with uneven wear between the two tires shown.
risks.proof: Photo of both tires side by side with tread facing camera, plus sidewalls.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit with unknown set consistency

proof_requests: Full sidewall photo showing brand, model, size (295/40R20 confirmation), load/speed rating, and DOT date code.
Tread depth measurement photo (coin or gauge in the groove).
Wide shot of both tires together, sidewalls facing camera, to check consistency.
Close-up of any cracks, bulges, or repair patches on the sidewall.
response.reason: The photo shows only tread with no sidewall, so the claimed size, brand, age, and true condition cannot be confirmed or even safely assumed at a worst-case price; a sidewall and tread-depth shot are needed before pricing.
